items.headline: Deshawn Purdie, Ethan Vasko guide Liberty to a 35-3 romp over Sam Houston
items.description: — Deshawn Purdie threw a touchdown pass before Ethan Vasko scored two of Liberty's four rushing touchdowns and the Flames spoiled Sam Houston's Conference USA opener with a 35-3 victory on Thursday night.

items.description: Sam Houston (1-3) at Liberty (4-1), Oct. 8 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Texas Tech linebacker returns INTs for TDs on consecutive passes
items.description: Texas Tech LB Austin Romaine returned two interceptions for touchdowns on consecutive passes thrown by Sam Houston on Saturday.
